name: Stick Wars: The Laneborn
summary: Stick Wars: The Laneborn is a 2D real-time lane-push strategy game drawn with hyper-stylized stickmen. Battles are fought across three lanes, where minions, towers, and enemy waves advance on their own, and victory comes from decisions rather than micromanagement: where to spend gold, which lane to break, and when to commit. Players upgrade towers and their base, deploy soldiers, archers, commanders, and siege catapults, and fight alongside allied champions such as the Warlock, the Minotaur, and the Hero Archer, while lane-switching enemy bosses grow stronger as the single-player campaign against the AI progresses.
